_note: kind beasts: species = id in animals.json (wolf, bear, lion...). kind raid: tribe = who attacks; size = how many guards the tribe sends, OR army = own make-up { weapon: count } (weapons of weapons.json: club, spear, mace, hatchet = foot; sling, bow = archers), with armor (default true). Enemy cavalry is not supported yet. day = first day of the window in the game year (year 2 adds 20). The event fires at a random day in [day, day + spread]. warnDays: how long before the first hint. size is capped by what the source really has.
